title: Security Evidence Accelerator & Customer Risk Onboarding Guidelines
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Problem: Enterprise customers repeatedly submit security and compliance questionnaires (SOC2, ISO, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA, vendor RFIs) with overlapping asks. Current workflow requires manual evidence collection across docs, Playbooks, and engineering PRs, causing slow response times and inconsistent answers. Objective: Build a Security Evidence Accelerator that standardizes mappings from customer asks to product artifacts, automates evidence bundle generation for common questionnaires, and surfaces a prioritized onboarding path for requests with customer-facing SLAs. This ticket scopes the PM work: requirements, stakeholder alignment, acceptance criteria, rollout milestones, and integration requirements with Confluence, Console, and Support systems.
acceptance_criteria: Mapping matrix covering SOC2, ISO27001, HIPAA/HITECH scopes, GDPR articles, and common DPA clauses produced and validated by Security and Legal

Automated evidence bundle generator that compiles relevant docs (SOC2 report stub, architecture diagram, encryption summary, KMS config, retention policy) into a downloadable ZIP for at least 3 common vendor questionnaires
Triage rubric that assigns requests to lanes (self-serve, concierge, sales-assisted) with SLA targets: self-serve <3 business days, concierge <7 business days, sales-assisted negotiated
Console integration: per-request dashboard card showing request lane, expected SLA, artifact links, and current assignee
Pilot with 10 real customer requests demonstrating median time-to-deliver <= 4 business days and >= 60% of items auto-bundled
Playbook and PR template for Eng/Infra to produce missing artifacts (audit logs, KMS proof, network diagrams) with owner and estimate fields
tasks: Inventory existing artifacts and map to standard control IDs (SOC2 CC, ISO A controls, HIPAA safeguards, GDPR Articles)
Work with Security/Legal to produce canonical text snippets and redaction rules for customer disclosure
Define triage rubric and lane definitions with Support and Sales; document SLA target per lane
Design evidence bundle schema and required metadata fields (artifact type, version, owner, last_updated, redaction_note)
Prototype a small generator (backend job + Confluence/GDrive connectors) that assembles bundles for 3 common questionnaires
Add a Console card UI wireframe and handoff to front-end with acceptance tests
Define metrics and instrumentation events for time-to-bundle, percent-automated, and SLA adherence
Prepare internal playbook content (Confluence) and training session for Support and Solutions Engineering
stakeholders: Engineering: Backend owner TBD, Console UI lead - Emily Zhao
success_metrics: Median time-to-deliver evidence bundle for triaged requests <= 4 business days
Percent of questionnaire items auto-mapped >= 60% during pilot
Reduction in duplicate artifact requests to Security by 50%
Positive NPS signal from pilot customers (qualitative feedback collected)
